records.title: MissionResultPolicyRecord physical layout
records.summary: Carry-forward evidence supports a 0x84-byte policy record with a 0x50-byte 5x4 float threshold region at +0x00, four aggregate floats at +0x50, a 0x14-byte five-value raw region at +0x60, and a 0x10-byte unresolved tail at +0x74. The containing observed group stride is 0x298, leaving one raw dword after five records.
